info.title: ByteAid.Tools.Ado.Cli
info.description: Azure DevOps CLI tool for working with project work items via Entra ID device code authentication

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: -h
options.description: Show help and usage information

commands.name: workitems
commands.description: List Azure DevOps work items for a project

options.name: --organization
options.description: Azure DevOps organization name

options.name: --project
options.description: Project name

options.name: --type
options.description: Filter by work item type (e.g. Bug, "User Story", Task)

options.name: --state
options.description: Filter by state (e.g. Active, Closed)

options.name: --tag
options.description: Filter by tag via WIQL CONTAINS (repeatable, e.g. bx: matches all bx:* tags)

options.name: --where
options.description: Raw WIQL boolean clause appended to the WHERE with AND

options.name: --field
options.description: Extra field reference name to surface in JSON output (repeatable, e.g. System.AssignedTo)

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit the stable machine-readable JSON contract on stdout instead of the human view

options.name: --tenant-id
options.description: Tenant ID backing the target org (omit to sign in to your home tenant)

options.name: --account
options.description: Account username to use when several are signed in (omit to use the first cached account)

options.name: --top
options.description: Maximum number of work items to return
